findings.description: At 01:19-01:20 the waitress is standing behind the counter wiping it. Within about half a second (01:20.0-01:20.5) her legs and apron appear on the customer side beneath the counter while her torso is still above the counter top, and by 01:21 she is seated on the stool beside the man. She never walks around the counter end; the end state (seated beside him) is reached with no physically possible path, so the transition dissolves the action instead of completing it.

In the last shot the waitress rises from a customer stool (01:51) and, in about 0.5 s (01:52.0-01:52.8), goes from the customer side to behind the counter: her legs stay on the stool side while her torso slides along behind the bar, with no walk around the counter end. At the same time (~01:52.0) a second waitress figure fades in at the far end of the counter with no entrance, works there for several seconds, then fades out or merges into the foreground figure around 01:56-01:57 with no exit.

The waitress pours a steady stream of coffee into the mug from 00:28 to 00:30, filling it, but the liquid level in the glass carafe looks about the same before the pour (00:27) and after it (00:31-00:32). The pour shows no matching loss of volume.
